title: Senate Majority Leader
summary: Senate Democrats choose their leader for the next Congress. Because Democrats won the Senate majority on November 3, 2026, their leader becomes Majority Leader.
who_votes: Senators and senators-elect in the Senate Democratic caucus for the 120th Congress, including independents who caucus with Democrats.
electorate_note: Reported as 54 to 56 seats, with results still being finalized.

candidates.name: Charles E. Schumer
candidates.note: Current Democratic leader. Said on November 4, 2026: "I'll be reelected as majority leader."

stages.name: Caucus vote
stages.when: Expected in early December 2026. No date has been announced.
stages.ballot: Secret ballot behind closed doors. No individual votes will be published, so public statements are the only record.

sources.title: Roll Call: 'I'll be reelected as majority leader,' Schumer says
Newsweek: Chuck Schumer in peril as voices grow against Senate majority leader

title: Speaker of the House
summary: The House elects its Speaker when the new Congress convenes. Before that, each party's members choose a nominee in private.
who_votes: For the nomination: House Democrats elected to the 120th Congress. For the floor vote: every member-elect of the House.
electorate_note: Reported as at least 254 Democrats and 165 Republicans, with some races undecided.

candidates.name: Hakeem Jeffries
candidates.note: Current House Democratic leader. Reported to have launched his bid on November 4, 2026, and to be unopposed for the nomination so far.

stages.name: House Democratic caucus vote on a nominee
stages.when: Scheduled for November 18, 2026, according to press reports.
stages.ballot: Behind closed doors. Individual votes are not expected to be published.

stages.name: Floor vote of the full House
stages.ballot: Public roll call. Each member's vote is recorded by name, so declarations can be compared with the recorded vote afterward.

sources.title: Newsweek: Jeffries' path to House speaker raises specter of McCarthy-style revolt
